package com.platform.events.iam.user;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public record UserCreatedData(
    int count,
    double ratio,
    Integer optCount,
    Double optRatio,
    List<Integer> ints,
    List<Double> nums
) {

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static UserCreatedData fromMap(Map<String, Object> map) {
        return new UserCreatedData(
            (Integer) map.get("count"),
            (Double) map.get("ratio"),
            (Integer) map.get("optCount"),
            (Double) map.get("optRatio"),
            (List<Integer>) map.get("ints"),
            (List<Double>) map.get("nums")
        );
    }

    public Map<String, Object> toMap() {
        var map = new LinkedHashMap<String, Object>();
        map.put("count", count);
        map.put("ratio", ratio);
        map.put("optCount", optCount);
        map.put("optRatio", optRatio);
        map.put("ints", ints);
        map.put("nums", nums);
        return map;
    }
}
